source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Chapter 14 (PDF 305-322), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh chapter 14 (Atmosphere) ke poore chapter se practice MCQs hain, chapter ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah; numerical sawalon mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.
Introduction: major, minor and trace components

blocks.prompt:
1 The major components of the atmosphere are:
(Atmosphere (fiza) ke major (bare) components kaun se hain?)
blocks.explanation: Major components nitrogen (taqreeban 78%) aur oxygen (taqreeban 21%) hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Major components are nitrogen (78.00%) and oxygen (21.01%)

blocks.prompt:
2 Argon (0.93%) and carbon dioxide (0.04%) are classed as which components of the atmosphere?
(Argon (0.93%) aur carbon dioxide (0.04%) atmosphere ke kis qisam ke components hain?)
blocks.explanation: Argon aur carbon dioxide minor (chhote) components hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Minor components are argon (0.93%), carbon dioxide (0.04%)

blocks.prompt:
3 Which of the following is a trace component of the atmosphere?
(In mein se kaun si gas atmosphere ka trace (bohat kam miqdaar wala) component hai?)
blocks.explanation: Trace components methane, hydrogen, neon, helium, krypton aur xenon hain (Introduction).

book_ref.quote: Trace components are methane, hydrogen, neon, helium, krypton, and xenon.

blocks.prompt:
4 Using the chapter's percentages, nitrogen and oxygen together make up about what percentage of the atmosphere?
(Chapter ke percentages se nitrogen aur oxygen mil kar atmosphere ka taqreeban kitna feesad hain?)

book_ref.quote: The atmosphere is a sphere of different gases around the earth.

blocks.prompt:
5 The four layers of the atmosphere are distinguished on the basis of:
(Atmosphere ki chaar layers (tehon) ko kis bunyad par alag kiya jata hai?)

options.text: bulandi barhne ke saath temperature ki tabdeeli

blocks.explanation: Layers ka faisla bulandi (altitude) barhne ke saath temperature ki tabdeeli se hota hai (14.1).

book_ref.quote: determined by the change in temperature that is observed with increasing altitude

blocks.prompt:
6 The troposphere extends from the ground up to about:
(Troposphere zameen se taqreeban kitni bulandi tak hai?)
blocks.explanation: Troposphere sab se neechi teh hai aur 12 km tak hai (14.1 i).

book_ref.quote: It is the lowest region of the atmosphere which extends up to 12 km.

blocks.prompt:
7 The densest layer of the atmosphere, in which rain, lightning and hurricanes occur, is the:
(Atmosphere ki sab se ghani (dense) teh jis mein barish, bijli aur toofan hote hain, kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Troposphere sab se ghani teh hai aur mausam ke bare waqiyat isi mein hote hain (14.1 i).

book_ref.quote: It is the densest layer of the atmosphere.

blocks.prompt:
8 In the troposphere the temperature falls from 17 °C to -58 °C over 12 km. What is the average fall in temperature per kilometre?
(Troposphere mein 12 km mein temperature 17 °C se -58 °C tak girta hai. Har kilometre par ausat kitna girta hai?)

book_ref.quote: In this region, temperature decreases from 17 °C to -58 °C regularly.

blocks.prompt:
9 The stratosphere lies at a height of:
(Stratosphere zameen se kitni bulandi par hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stratosphere zameen se 12-50 km upar hai (14.1 ii).

book_ref.quote: at a distance of 12-50 km above the earth surface

blocks.prompt:
10 In the stratosphere, temperature:
(Stratosphere mein temperature ka kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stratosphere mein temperature -58 °C se -2 °C tak barhta hai (14.1 ii).

book_ref.quote: Temperature increases from -58 °C to -2 °C.

blocks.prompt:
11 In the upper stratosphere, ozone absorbs high-energy UV radiation and breaks down into:
(Upper stratosphere mein ozone UV shuaon ko jazb kar ke kis mein toot jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: UV roshni (hν) mein O₃(g) → O₂(g) + O(g) (14.1 ii).

book_ref.quote: Since ozone in the upper layer absorbs high energy ultraviolet radiations from the Sun.

blocks.prompt:
12 In the middle stratosphere the reaction O₂(g) + O(g) → O₃(g) is:
(Darmiyani stratosphere mein reaction O₂(g) + O(g) → O₃(g) kis qisam ka hai?)
blocks.explanation: Monoatomic aur diatomic oxygen mil kar ozone banate hain; yeh exothermic (garmi kharij karne wala) reaction hai aur is se ozone layer banti hai (14.1 ii).

book_ref.quote: monoatomic oxygen and diatomic oxygen recombine to form ozone which is an exothermic reaction

blocks.prompt:
13 According to the chapter, ozone is not formed in the lower stratosphere because:
(Chapter ke mutabiq lower stratosphere mein ozone kyun nahi banti?)

options.text: barish sari ozone khatam kar deti hai
wahan bohat kam UV pohanchti hai is liye monoatomic oxygen nahi hoti

blocks.explanation: Lower stratosphere tak bohat kam UV pohanchti hai, is liye monoatomic oxygen nahi hoti aur ozone nahi banti (14.1 ii).

book_ref.quote: The lower stratosphere receives very low ultraviolet radiations

blocks.prompt:
14 The coldest region of the atmosphere is found in the:
(Atmosphere ka sab se thanda hissa kis teh mein hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mesosphere mein temperature -93 °C tak girta hai; sab se thanda hissa isi mein hai (14.1 iii).

book_ref.quote: The coldest region of the atmosphere is located in this layer.

blocks.prompt:
15 The mesosphere extends from about:
(Mesosphere taqreeban kahan se kahan tak hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mesosphere zameen se taqreeban 50-85 km tak hai (14.1 iii).

book_ref.quote: It extends to a height of about 50 – 85 km from the ground.

blocks.prompt:
16 The temperature in the thermosphere rises with altitude because of:
(Thermosphere mein bulandi ke saath temperature kyun barhta hai?)

options.text: ozone bante waqt nikalne wali garmi
taaqatwar UV aur X-rays ka jazb hona

blocks.explanation: Yeh izafa taaqatwar UV aur X-rays ke jazb (absorption) hone se hota hai (14.1 iv).

book_ref.quote: The increase in the temperature is caused due to the absorption of energetic ultra-violet (UV) and X-rays.

blocks.prompt:
17 The temperature in the upper thermosphere can range from:
(Upper thermosphere mein temperature kitna ho sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Upper thermosphere ka temperature 500 °C se 2000 °C ya is se zyada ho sakta hai (14.1 iv).

book_ref.quote: Temperature in the upper thermosphere can range from 500 °C to 2000 °C or higher.

blocks.prompt:
18 In which two layers does the temperature increase with increasing altitude?
(Kin do tehon mein bulandi barhne ke saath temperature barhta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Stratosphere mein -58 °C se -2 °C tak aur thermosphere (85-600 km) mein bulandi ke saath temperature barhta hai (14.1).

book_ref.quote: It extends from 85 km to 600 km above the earth surface.

blocks.prompt:
19 Pollutants are best described as:
(Pollutants (aaloodgi phelane wale maadde) ki behtareen tareef kya hai?)

options.text: gases, liquids aur solids jo mahol ke liye nuqsan deh hain
sirf gases jo nuqsan deh hain
woh maadde jo hawa ka bara hissa hain

blocks.explanation: Pollutants woh maadde (gases, liquids aur solids) hain jo mahol ke liye nuqsan deh hain (14.2).

book_ref.quote: Pollutants are substances (gases, liquids and solids) that are harmful to the environment.

blocks.prompt:
20 Carbon monoxide from a motor vehicle exhaust is an example of a:
(Gaari ke dhuen se nikalne wali carbon monoxide kis ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Primary pollutants seedhe kharij hote hain, jaise gaari ke dhuen ki CO (14.2).

book_ref.quote: Primary pollutants are substances directly produced or emitted

blocks.prompt:
21 Secondary pollutants are formed by:
(Secondary pollutants kaise bante hain?)

options.text: volcano se seedha kharij ho kar
primary pollutants ke chemical reactions se
gaari ke dhuen se seedha kharij ho kar
samandar ke paani ke bukharat se

blocks.explanation: Secondary pollutants primary pollutants ke kimiyai reactions se bante hain (14.2).

book_ref.quote: Secondary pollutants are formed due to chemical reactions of primary pollutants.

blocks.prompt:
22 The pollutants collectively known as NOₓ are:
(Kin pollutants ko mila kar NOₓ kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nitrogen ke oxides NO aur NO₂ ko mila kar NOₓ kehte hain (14.2).

book_ref.quote: Oxides of Nitrogen (NO and NO₂) collectively known as NOₓ

blocks.prompt:
23 Which set lists the heavy metals named as air pollutants in the chapter?
(Chapter mein hawa ki aaloodgi wali heavy metals kaun si batayi gayi hain?)
blocks.explanation: Pollutants mein heavy metals Pb, Hg aur Cd batayi gayi hain (14.2).

book_ref.quote: Heavy Metals (Pb, Hg and Cd)

blocks.prompt:
24 Which natural event produces significant quantities of NOₓ?
(Kaun sa qudrati waqiya NOₓ ki kaafi miqdaar paida karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aasmani bijli (thunderbolt) nitrogen ke oxides ki kaafi miqdaar banati hai (14.3.1).

book_ref.quote: Thunderbolt produces significant quantities of oxides of nitrogen (NOₓ).

blocks.prompt:
25 According to the chapter, algae on the surface of the oceans give out:
(Chapter ke mutabiq samandar ki satah par algae kaun si gas kharij karti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Samandar ki satah par algae H₂S kharij karti hai (14.3.1).

book_ref.quote: algae on the surface of the oceans, which gives out hydrogen sulphide (H₂S)

blocks.prompt:
26 Swamps and other humid zones are a natural source of:
(Daldal (swamps) aur doosre nam ilaqe kis gas ka qudrati zariya hain?)
blocks.explanation: Daldal jaise nam ilaqe methane paida karte hain (14.3.1).

book_ref.quote: humid zones such as swamps, peat-bags or little deep lakes, which produce methane (CH₄)

blocks.prompt:
27 Factories and electric power plants are examples of:
(Factories aur bijli ghar kis qisam ke sources hain?)

options.text: point sources (aik jagah par qaim zariye)

blocks.explanation: Insani sources mobile (gaariyan, jahaz) ya point sources (factories, bijli ghar) hote hain (14.3.2).

book_ref.quote: point sources (factories, electric power plants etc.)

blocks.prompt:
28 Which of the following is a mobile source of air pollution?
(In mein se kaun sa hawa ki aaloodgi ka mobile (chalta phirta) source hai?)
blocks.explanation: Mobile sources gaariyan, truck, hawai jahaz aur samandari engine hain (14.3.2).

book_ref.quote: Such sources can be classified as either mobile (cars, trucks, air planes, marine engines)

blocks.prompt:
29 Carbon monoxide is produced mainly by:
(Carbon monoxide zyada tar kaise banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: CO zyada tar namukammal jalne (incomplete combustion) se banti hai: 2C(s) + O₂(g) → 2CO(g) (14.4.1).

book_ref.quote: Carbon monoxide (CO) is produced mainly due to incomplete combustion of fossil fuels.

blocks.prompt:
30 Carbon monoxide is poisonous because it:
(Carbon monoxide zehreeli kyun hai?)

options.text: barish mein ghul kar acid banati hai
haemoglobin se oxygen se zyada mazbooti se judti hai

blocks.explanation: CO khoon ki haemoglobin se oxygen se zyada mazbooti se judti hai aur oxygen ko saans ke amal se bahar kar deti hai (14.4.1).

book_ref.quote: It binds blood hemoglobin more strongly than oxygen

blocks.prompt:
31 Carbon monoxide poisoning can be reversed by giving:
(Carbon monoxide ka zehar kis tarah utara ja sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: CO ka zehar zyada pressure wali oxygen de kar utara ja sakta hai (14.4.1).

book_ref.quote: The CO poisonous can be reversed by giving high pressure oxygen.

blocks.prompt:
32 The key greenhouse gas emitted by human activities such as combustion of fossil fuels is:
(Fossil fuels jalane jaisi insani sargarmiyon se nikalne wali ahem greenhouse gas kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: CO₂ insani sargarmiyon se nikalne wali ahem greenhouse gas hai; yeh garmi rokti hai (14.4.1).

book_ref.quote: Carbon dioxide (CO₂) is a primary greenhouse gas that traps heat in the atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
33 Nitrogen and oxygen combine to form nitric oxide, N₂(g) + O₂(g) → 2NO(g), under the condition of:
(Nitrogen aur oxygen kis shart par mil kar nitric oxide banate hain?)
blocks.explanation: N₂ aur O₂ bohat zyada temperature par NO banate hain (14.4.2).

book_ref.quote: NOₓ is produced as a result of the following chemical reactions:

blocks.prompt:
34 Nitric oxide reacts further with oxygen to give:
(Nitric oxide oxygen se mazeed reaction kar ke kya banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2NO(g) + O₂ → 2NO₂ (nitrogen dioxide) (14.4.2).

book_ref.quote: It is generally produced from burning fossil fuels.

blocks.prompt:
35 A natural source of nitrous oxide (N₂O) is:
(Nitrous oxide (N₂O) ka aik qudrati zariya kya hai?)

options.text: mitti aur samandar mein microbes (jaraseem) ka amal

blocks.explanation: Qudrati N₂O mitti aur samandar mein bacteria ke amal se banti hai (14.4.2).

book_ref.quote: Natural sources of N₂O include microbial processes in soil and oceans

blocks.prompt:
36 A human activity that releases N₂O is:
(N₂O kharij karne wali aik insani sargarmi kya hai?)

options.text: kheti mein masnooi khaad (synthetic fertilizer) ka istemal

blocks.explanation: N₂O ke insani zariye zarai sargarmiyan (masnooi khaad) aur sanati combustion hain (14.4.2).

book_ref.quote: Human activities include agricultural activities (synthetic fertilizers)

blocks.prompt:
37 Oxides of sulphur (SOₓ) are emitted primarily by:
(Sulphur ke oxides (SOₓ) zyada tar kis se kharij hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: SO₂ aur SO₃ zyada tar coal aur tel jalane se kharij hote hain (14.4.3).

book_ref.quote: These gases are emitted primarily by burning coal and oil.

blocks.prompt:
38 The major source of acid deposition in the air is:
(Hawa mein acid jama hone (acid deposition) ka sab se bara zariya kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: SO₂ acid deposition ka sab se bara zariya hai (14.4.3).

book_ref.quote: SO₂ is the major source of acid deposition in the air.

blocks.prompt:
39 The most common hydrocarbon air pollutant is:
(Sab se aam hydrocarbon air pollutant kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Methane sab se aam hydrocarbon aur air pollutant hai (14.4.4).

book_ref.quote: Methane is the most common hydrocarbon and air pollutant.

blocks.prompt:
40 The major source of hydrocarbon emission is:
(Hydrocarbons ke ikhraj (emission) ka sab se bara zariya kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Gaariyan (automobiles) hydrocarbon emission ka sab se bara zariya hain (14.4.4).

book_ref.quote: Automobiles are the major source of hydrocarbon emission.

blocks.prompt:
41 Low-altitude ozone harms rubber, fabric dyes and paints because it is a:
(Zameen ke qareeb ozone rubber, kapre ke rang aur paint ko kyun nuqsan deti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Ozone taaqatwar oxidizing agent (taksiddi amil) hai, is liye insanon, paudon, rubber, rang aur paint ko nuqsan deti hai (14.4.5).

book_ref.quote: Ozone is a powerful oxidizing agent.

blocks.prompt:
42 The decrease in the concentration of ozone in the stratosphere is called:
(Stratosphere mein ozone ki miqdaar kam hone ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Stratosphere mein ozone ki kami ko ozone depletion (ozone ka khatam hona) kehte hain (14.4.6).

book_ref.quote: The decrease in the concentration of ozone in stratosphere is called depletion of ozone.

blocks.prompt:
43 At room temperature, chlorofluorocarbons exist as:
(Kamre ke temperature par CFCs kis haalat mein hote hain?)

options.text: gas ya kam boiling point wale liquids

blocks.explanation: CFCs kamre ke temperature par gas ya kam boiling point wale liquids hote hain (14.4.6).

book_ref.quote: These compounds exist as gases or low boiling liquids at room temperature

blocks.prompt:
44 In the stratosphere, UV radiation breaks a CFC molecule such as CFCl₃ to set free a:
(Stratosphere mein UV shuaen CFCl₃ jaise CFC molecule ko tor kar kya azad karti hain?)
blocks.explanation: UV mein CFCl₃ → CFCl₂ + Cl•; yeh chlorine atom hai jis mein aik akela electron hai, chloride ion nahi (Book correction) (14.4.6).

book_ref.quote: where they are broken down by UV radiation creating chloride free radical (Cl•)

blocks.prompt:
45 In the reaction Cl• + O₃ → ClO• + O₂, the chlorine free radical:
(Reaction Cl• + O₃ → ClO• + O₂ mein chlorine free radical kya karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Cl• ozone ko torta hai aur ClO• aur O₂ bante hain; phir Cl• dobara azad ho kar agli O₃ torta hai (14.4.6).

book_ref.quote: The formation of another chlorine free radical in the last step that can further break down another molecule of O₃.

blocks.prompt:
46 The balanced step that sets the chlorine free radical free again in the ozone-destroying cycle is:
(Ozone tabah karne wale cycle mein woh balanced qadam kaun sa hai jo chlorine free radical ko dobara azad karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Book correction ke mutabiq qadam ClO• + O → Cl• + O₂ hai (chhapa hua ClO• + O₂ → Cl• + O₂ balanced nahi) (14.4.6).

book_ref.quote: The 2nd and the 3rd steps are repeated many times.

blocks.prompt:
47 If one CFC molecule can destroy up to 100,000 ozone molecules, up to how many ozone molecules can 25 CFC molecules destroy?
(Agar aik CFC molecule 100,000 tak ozone molecules tabah kar sakta hai to 25 CFC molecules kitne tak tabah kar sakte hain?)

book_ref.quote: The decomposition of one molecule of CFCs can destroy up to 100,000 molecules of ozone.

blocks.prompt:
48 CFCs released at the ground destroy ozone after they:
(Zameen par kharij hone wale CFCs ozone ko kab tabah karte hain?)

options.text: stratosphere tak phail kar UV se toot jate hain
barish ke paani mein ghul jate hain
jangal unhein jazb kar lete hain
troposphere mein SO₂ se reaction karte hain

blocks.explanation: CFCs stratosphere tak phail jate hain jahan UV unhein tor kar chlorine free radicals banati hai jo O₃ tabah karte hain (14.4.6).

book_ref.quote: Chlorofluorocarbons are known to diffuse into the stratosphere

blocks.prompt:
49 Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) are composed of:
(Polycyclic aromatic hydrocarbons (PAHs) kis se bane hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: PAHs kai jure hue aromatic rings se bane hote hain (14.4.7).

book_ref.quote: composed of fused multiple aromatic rings are common environmental pollutants

blocks.prompt:
50 Which of the following is an example of a PAH?
(In mein se kaun sa PAH ki misaal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Naphthalene, anthracene aur phenanthrene (Book correction) PAHs ki misalein hain (14.4.7).

book_ref.quote: They are generated primarily during the incomplete combustion of fossil fuels

blocks.prompt:
51 PAHs are generated primarily during:
(PAHs zyada tar kab bante hain?)
blocks.explanation: PAHs zyada tar coal, tel, petrol aur lakri ke namukammal jalne se bante hain, grill kiye khanon mein bhi (14.4.7).

book_ref.quote: Some PAHs in the environment originate from the natural sources

blocks.prompt:
52 Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) are organic compounds that:
(Persistent organic pollutants (POPs) kaise organic compounds hain?)

options.text: kamre ke temperature par jaldi urr jate hain
dhoop se jaldi toot jate hain
chemical, biological aur photolytic tootne ke khilaf mazboot hain

blocks.explanation: POPs kimiyai, hayatiyati aur roshni (photolytic) amal se tootne ke khilaf mazahmat karte hain (14.4.8).

book_ref.quote: These are organic compounds that are resistant to degradation through chemical, biological and photolytic processes.

blocks.prompt:
53 According to Table 14.1, polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) are used in:
(Table 14.1 ke mutabiq polychlorinated biphenyls (PCBs) kahan istemal hote hain?)

options.text: bijli ka saman, ink, adhesives aur paint

blocks.explanation: PCBs bijli ke saman, ink, gond (adhesives) aur paint mein istemal hote hain (Table 14.1).

book_ref.quote: Used in electrical equipment, surface coating ink, adhesives and paints

blocks.prompt:
54 The POP DDT (dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane) is used as:
(POP DDT kis kaam aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: DDT kheti mein keera maar dawa (insecticide) hai; is ka durust naam dichlorodiphenyltrichloroethane hai (Table 14.1, Book correction).

book_ref.quote: Used as an insecticide in agriculture

blocks.prompt:
55 POPs can affect people and wildlife far from where they were released because they:
(POPs apne ikhraj ki jagah se door logon aur janwaron ko kyun mutasir kar sakte hain?)

options.text: dhoop se fauran khatam ho jate hain
sirf usi mitti mein rehte hain
der tak qaim rehte hain aur hawa aur paani se door jate hain
beziyaan gas mein badal jate hain

blocks.explanation: POPs der tak qaim rehte hain aur hawa aur paani se door tak jate hain (14.4.8).

book_ref.quote: Most POPs are generated in one country can affect people and wildlife far from where they are used and released.

blocks.prompt:
56 Volatile organic compounds (VOCs) are organic compounds that:
(Volatile organic compounds (VOCs) kaise organic compounds hain?)

options.text: kamre ke temperature par asaani se urr jate hain
sirf jure hue aromatic rings se bane hain

blocks.explanation: VOCs organic compounds ka bara group hai jo kamre ke temperature par asaani se urr jate hain (14.4.9).

book_ref.quote: A large group of organic compounds that easily evaporates at room temperature.

blocks.prompt:
57 The major sources of VOCs that affect outdoor air quality are:
(Bahar ki hawa ko mutasir karne wale VOCs ka bara zariya kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Liquid fuels (maye eendhan) VOCs ka bara zariya hain (14.4.9).

book_ref.quote: Liquid fuels are major sources of VOCs that impact outdoor air quality.

blocks.prompt:
58 A long-term effect of exposure to VOCs is:
(VOCs se lambe arse tak wasta parne ka aik asar kya hai?)

options.text: jigar, gurde aur central nervous system ko nuqsan

blocks.explanation: Kam arse mein aankh, naak, gale ki jalan, sar dard, matli; lambe arse mein jigar, gurde aur markazi asabi nizam ko nuqsan (14.4.9).

book_ref.quote: damage to the liver, kidney and central nervous system are long term exposures

blocks.prompt:
59 Which of the following is a common VOC named in the chapter?
(Chapter mein batayi gayi aam VOC kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aam VOCs: benzene, xylene, toluene, ethanol, formaldehyde, acetone (14.4.9).

book_ref.quote: Some common VOCs are benzene, xylene, toluene, ethanol, formaldehyde and acetone

blocks.prompt:
60 Particulate matter (PM) refers to tiny substances floating in the air as:
(Particulate matter (PM) hawa mein tairte kin barik maaddon ko kehte hain?)

options.text: thos zarre, maye qatre ya dono

blocks.explanation: PM hawa mein tairte barik thos zarre ya maye qatre ya dono hain (14.4.10).

book_ref.quote: float in the air in the form of either solid particles or liquid droplets or both

blocks.prompt:
61 Which of the following is a man-made source of particulate matter?
(In mein se particulate matter ka insani (man-made) zariya kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Insani PM zariye combustion, gaariyon ka dhuan aur tobacco ka dhuan hain; baqi qudrati hain (14.4.10).

book_ref.quote: Natural sources include volcanoes, fires, dust storms, and aerosolized sea salt.

blocks.prompt:
62 The major sources of heavy-metal air pollutants are:
(Heavy metals wali hawai aaloodgi ke bare zariye kaun se hain?)

options.text: metallurgy, battery ka kachra aur incineration

blocks.explanation: Metallurgy (dhaat saazi), battery ka kachra aur incineration (kachra jalana) bare zariye hain (14.4.11).

book_ref.quote: Metallurgy, battery waste and incineration are their major sources.

blocks.text: 14.5 Impact of human activities on the atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
63 Human activities affect the atmosphere primarily through:
(Insani sargarmiyan atmosphere ko zyada tar kis tarah mutasir karti hain?)

options.text: fossil fuels jalana aur jangal kaatna

blocks.explanation: Atmosphere par insani asar zyada tar fossil fuels jalane aur jangal kaatne se hai (14.5).

book_ref.quote: primarily through the burning fossil fuels and deforestation

blocks.text: 14.5.1 Impact of burning fossil fuels on the atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
64 The primary cause of current climate change is:
(Maujooda mausami tabdeeli (climate change) ki bunyadi wajah kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Fossil fuels jalana maujooda climate change ki bunyadi wajah hai (14.5.1).

book_ref.quote: The burning of fossil fuels is the primary cause of current climate change

blocks.text: 14.5.2 Impact of deforestation on the atmosphere

blocks.prompt:
65 Deforestation is:
(Deforestation kya hai?)

options.text: insanon ka jaan boojh kar jangal saaf ya kam karna

blocks.explanation: Deforestation insanon ka jaan boojh kar jangal saaf karna ya kam karna hai (14.5.2).

book_ref.quote: Deforestation is purposeful cleaning or thinning of forests by humans.

blocks.prompt:
66 Deforestation adds to climate change mainly because forests:
(Jangal kaatna climate change ko kyun barhata hai?)

options.text: CO₂ jaisi greenhouse gases jazb karte hain

blocks.explanation: Jangal CO₂ jaisi greenhouse gases jazb karte hain; inhein kaatne se hawa mein CO₂ zyada rehti hai (14.5.2).

book_ref.quote: Forests absorb GHGs like CO₂ and clean air for us.

blocks.prompt:
67 Smog is a type of air pollution typically characterized by:
(Smog kis cheez se pehchani jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: Smog ghane dhundle pan (thick haze) wali aaloodgi hai, zyada tar shehron mein (14.6.1).

book_ref.quote: Smog is a type of air pollution typically characterized by a thick haze.

blocks.prompt:
68 Classical (industrial) smog is also called London smog. It results mainly from high quantities of:
(Classical (industrial) smog ko London smog bhi kehte hain. Yeh zyada tar kis ki ziyada miqdaar se banti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sulphurous ya industrial smog hawa mein SOₓ ki ziyada miqdaar se banti hai (14.6.1).

book_ref.quote: It is also called London smog.

blocks.prompt:
69 Sulphurous smog is also called:
(Sulphurous smog ko aur kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sulphurous smog ko reducing smog ya classical smog bhi kehte hain (14.6.1).

book_ref.quote: also called as “Reducing smog or Classical Smog”

blocks.prompt:
70 Photochemical smog is also known as:
(Photochemical smog ko kya kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Photochemical smog ko Los Angeles smog kehte hain; industrial smog London smog hai (14.6.1).

book_ref.quote: undergo photochemical reactions in the presence of sunlight

blocks.prompt:
71 PAN, formed in photochemical smog, stands for:
(Photochemical smog mein banne wala PAN kis ka mukhaffaf hai?)
blocks.explanation: NOₓ, VOCs aur unburned hydrocarbons dhoop mein reaction kar ke ozone aur peroxyacetyl nitrates (PAN) banate hain (14.6.1).

book_ref.quote: form secondary pollutants like ozone and peroxyacetyl nitrates (PAN)

blocks.prompt:
72 Photochemical smog is considered more dangerous because it can cause:
(Photochemical smog zyada khatarnak kyun samjhi jati hai?)

options.text: dil ki tez dharkan, pneumonia aur lung cancer

blocks.explanation: Photochemical smog dil ki dharkan tez hona, pneumonia aur lung cancer tak paida kar sakti hai (14.6.1).

book_ref.quote: This type of smog is considered more dangerous

blocks.prompt:
73 Rain is called acid rain when its pH is:
(Barish ko acid rain kab kaha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Book correction: jab barish ka pH 5.6 se kam ho to acid rain hai; saaf barish bhi thori tezabi (taqreeban 5.6) hoti hai (14.6.2).

book_ref.quote: Acid rain looks, feels and tastes like clean rain.

blocks.prompt:
74 In acid rain formation, SO₃ reacts with water to form:
(Acid rain bante waqt SO₃ paani se mil kar kya banati hai?)
blocks.explanation: 2SO₂ + O₂ → 2SO₃, phir SO₃(g) + H₂O(l) → H₂SO₄(aq) (14.6.2).

book_ref.quote: SO₂ from fossil fuels is oxidized to SO₃ which then reacts with water to form sulphuric acid.

blocks.prompt:
75 The correct balanced equation for formation of nitric and nitrous acids in acid rain is:
(Acid rain mein nitric aur nitrous acid banne ki durust balanced equation kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Book correction: nitrogen dioxide hi yeh do acids deti hai: 2NO₂(g) + H₂O(ℓ) → HNO₃(aq) + HNO₂(aq) (14.6.2).

book_ref.quote: Nitrogen oxide reacts with water to produce nitric acid and nitrous acid.

blocks.prompt:
76 Acid rain can damage places far away from the source of SOₓ and NOₓ because:
(Acid rain SOₓ aur NOₓ ke source se door jagahon ko kyun nuqsan de sakti hai?)

options.text: acids sirf source par bante hain
acid rain sirf factories ke qareeb girti hai
hawa tezabi qatron ko bohat door le jati hai
dhoop acids ko neutral kar deti hai

blocks.explanation: Hawa tezabi qatron ko bohat door le jati hai, phir woh acid rain, ole, barf ya dhund ban kar girte hain (14.6.2).

book_ref.quote: Wind can carry these acidic droplets to huge distance.

blocks.prompt:
77 The progressive warming of the earth's surface due to the blanketing effect of certain gases is called:
(Kuch gases ke kambal jaise asar se zameen ki satah ka barhta hua garam hona kya kehlata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Yeh greenhouse effect ki definition hai (14.7).

book_ref.quote: The progressive warming up of the earth’s surface due to blanketing effect of greenhouse gases

blocks.prompt:
78 Global warming refers to:
(Global warming se kya muraad hai?)

options.text: zameen ke ausat satahi temperature mein lamba izafa
dhoop se zameen ka rozana garam hona
ozone bante waqt nikalne wali garmi

blocks.explanation: Global warming zameen ke ausat satahi temperature mein lamba izafa hai jo insani GHG ikhraj se hai (14.7).

book_ref.quote: Global warming refers to the long-term rise in the Earth’s average surface temperature

blocks.prompt:
79 Carbon dioxide and water vapour in the atmosphere:
(Atmosphere mein carbon dioxide aur paani ke bukharat kya karte hain?)

options.text: lambi wavelength ki garmi azad chhorte hain
chhoti wavelength ki dhoop guzarne dete hain, lambi wavelength ki garmi rokte hain

blocks.explanation: CO₂ aur bukharat chhoti wavelength wali dhoop ko guzarne dete hain magar zameen se aane wali lambi wavelength ki garmi ko wapas bhejte hain (14.7).

book_ref.quote: transmit short wavelength solar radiations

blocks.prompt:
80 The greenhouse effect is based on the ability of certain gases to absorb:
(Greenhouse effect kuch gases ki kis shuaen jazb karne ki salahiyat par mabni hai?)
blocks.explanation: Greenhouse effect gases ke infrared shuaen jazb karne par mabni hai (14.7).

book_ref.quote: The greenhouse effect is a phenomenon which is based on the gases to absorb infra-red radiations.

blocks.prompt:
81 According to the chapter, as the concentration of CO₂ and other greenhouse gases rises:
(Chapter ke mutabiq jab CO₂ aur doosri greenhouse gases ki miqdaar barhti hai to:)

options.text: zyada garmi jazb hoti hai aur aalmi temperature zyada barhta hai
ozone layer moti ho jati hai
zameen raat ko zyada garmi kho deti hai

blocks.explanation: CO₂ waghaira ki miqdaar jitni zyada, garmi ka jazb aur aalmi temperature ka izafa utna zyada (14.7).

book_ref.quote: greater will be the absorption of thermal radiations

blocks.prompt:
82 Which oxide of nitrogen is a greenhouse gas (as in the corrected Figure 14.5)?
(Nitrogen ka kaun sa oxide greenhouse gas hai (durust Figure 14.5 ke mutabiq)?)
blocks.explanation: Book correction: greenhouse gas N₂O (nitrous oxide) hai, NO₂ nahi (14.7).

book_ref.quote: the greenhouse gas is N₂O (nitrous oxide), as drawn above

blocks.prompt:
83 The Air Quality Index (AQI) is a measure of:
(Air Quality Index (AQI) kis cheez ka paimana hai?)

options.text: kisi jagah ki hawa mein pollutants ki miqdaar

blocks.explanation: AQI kisi jagah ki hawa mein pollutants ki miqdaar (concentration) ka paimana hai (14.8).

book_ref.quote: AQI is a measure of the concentrations of pollutants present in the air at a particular location.

blocks.prompt:
84 An AQI value over 300 is considered:
(300 se zyada AQI ko kya samjha jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: 300 se zyada AQI hazardous (khatarnak) hai (14.8, Table 14.2).

book_ref.quote: An AQI over 300 is considered hazardous.

blocks.prompt:
85 Which group is under high risk when the AQI is hazardous?
(Hazardous AQI par kaun sa group zyada khatre mein hai?)

options.text: saaf hawa mein andar rehne wale
65 saal se zyada umar ke log

blocks.explanation: 18 se kam umar ke bachay, 65 se zyada umar ke log aur dil/phephron ke purane mareez zyada khatre mein hain (14.8).

book_ref.quote: Children under 18, adult over 65, people with chronic heart, and lung diseases are under high-risk.

blocks.prompt:
86 Outdoor workers are at higher risk from poor air quality because of:
(Bahar kaam karne wale log kharab hawa se zyada khatre mein kyun hain?)

options.text: lambe arse tak aaloodgi ke saamne rehna

blocks.explanation: Bahar kaam karne wale lambe arse tak aaloodgi ke saamne rehte hain (14.8).

book_ref.quote: Outdoor workers are at higher risk because of the prolonged exposure.

blocks.prompt:
87 On the AQI scale (Table 14.2), a value of 135 falls in the level:
(AQI scale (Table 14.2) par 135 qeemat kis darje mein aati hai?)
blocks.explanation: 101 se 150 Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups hai, rang orange (Table 14.2).

book_ref.quote: Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups

blocks.prompt:
88 On the AQI scale, a reading of 250 is shown in which colour?
(AQI scale par 250 ki reading kis rang se dikhayi jati hai?)
blocks.explanation: 201 se 300 Very Unhealthy hai, rang purple (jamni) (Table 14.2).

book_ref.quote: Table 14.2 AQI and level of health concern

blocks.prompt:
89 The colour used for the 'Hazardous' level (AQI 301 to 500) is:
('Hazardous' darje (AQI 301 se 500) ka rang kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: 301 se 500 Hazardous hai, rang maroon (Table 14.2).

book_ref.quote: Table 14.2 AQI and level of health concern

blocks.prompt:
90 Poor air quality can result when pollutants are trapped near the ground by:
(Kharab hawa tab ho sakti hai jab pollutants zameen ke qareeb kis cheez se qaid ho jayen?)
blocks.explanation: Garam hawa ki aik teh pollutants ko zameen ke qareeb qaid kar ke hawa kharab kar sakti hai (14.8.1).

book_ref.quote: A layer of warm air trapping pollutants near the ground can lead to poor air quality.

blocks.prompt:
91 Seasonal pollen concentration affecting air quality belongs to which factor?
(Mausami pollen ka hawa par asar kis factor mein aata hai?)
blocks.explanation: Seasonal changes (mausami tabdeeliyan) mein imaraton ko garam/thanda karna aur mausami pollen shamil hain (14.8.1).

book_ref.quote: Seasonal pollen concentration can contribute to poor air quality.

blocks.prompt:
92 Wildfires and natural dust storms affect air quality under the factor:
(Jangal ki aag aur qudrati mitti ke toofan kis factor ke tehat hawa ko mutasir karte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Natural events (qudrati waqiyat): jangal ki aag dhuan aur PM chhorti hai; mitti ke toofan hawa kharab karte hain (14.8.1).

book_ref.quote: Natural dust storms can significantly lower air quality.

blocks.text: 14.9 Link between air quality and human health

blocks.prompt:
93 The health impacts of poor air quality can be:
(Kharab hawa ke sehat par asraat kaise ho sakte hain?)

options.text: fauri aur lambe arse ke dono

blocks.explanation: Kharab hawa ke fauri aur lambe arse ke dono asraat ho sakte hain (14.9).

book_ref.quote: Poor air quality can have immediate and long-term health impacts.

blocks.text: 14.9.1 Major air pollutants and their health effects

blocks.prompt:
94 Inhaling particulate matter can cause inflammation of the airways leading to:
(Particulate matter saans ke saath andar jane se saans ki nalyon ki soojan se kya hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: PM saans ki nalyon mein soojan aur jalan paida kar ke asthma aur bronchitis tak le jata hai (14.9.1).

book_ref.quote: Inhalation of these particulate matter (PM) can cause inflammation and irritation of airways

blocks.prompt:
95 Long-term exposure to NO₂ and SO₂ can increase the risk of:
(NO₂ aur SO₂ se lambe arse tak wasta parne se kis ka khatra barhta hai?)

options.text: saans ki infection, asthma aur bronchitis

blocks.explanation: Kam arse mein saans ke nizam mein jalan; lambe arse mein saans ki infection, asthma aur bronchitis ka khatra (14.9.1).

book_ref.quote: The short-term exposures of NO₂ and SO₂ can irritate the respiratory system

blocks.text: 14.10 Potential health risks associated with air pollution

blocks.prompt:
96 The health effects of air pollution depend on:
(Hawai aaloodgi ke sehat par asraat kin baaton par munhasir hain?)

options.text: pollutant ki qisam aur miqdaar, muddat aur shakhsi kamzori

blocks.explanation: Asraat acute (fauri) ya chronic (purane) ho sakte hain aur pollutant ki qisam aur miqdaar, muddat aur shakhsi kamzori par munhasir hain (14.10).

book_ref.quote: The potential health effects can be acute or chronic

blocks.text: 14.10.1 Main health risks associated with air pollution

blocks.prompt:
97 Ozone, PM and NO₂ can trigger:
(Ozone, PM aur NO₂ kis cheez ko bhadka sakte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Ozone, PM aur NO₂ asthma ki alamaat barha kar asthma ka daura la sakte hain (14.10.1).

book_ref.quote: can increase asthma symptoms and trigger asthma attack

blocks.prompt:
98 Particulate matter increases the risk of heart attack by causing:
(Particulate matter dil ke daure ka khatra kaise barhata hai?)

options.text: soojan, khoon ki nalyon ko nuqsan aur high blood pressure

blocks.explanation: PM soojan, khoon ki nalyon ko nuqsan aur high blood pressure se dil ke daure ka khatra barhata hai (14.10.1).

book_ref.quote: Exposure to particular matters and other pollutants can increase the risk of heart attack

blocks.prompt:
99 Prolonged exposure to PM and carcinogenic compounds such as benzene can cause:
(PM aur benzene jaise cancer paida karne wale compounds se lamba wasta kya paida kar sakta hai?)
blocks.explanation: PM aur carcinogenic (cancer paida karne wale) compounds se lamba wasta lung cancer paida karta hai (14.10.1).

book_ref.quote: carcinogenic compounds (benzene formation) cause lung cancer

blocks.prompt:
100 A reproductive and developmental effect of air pollution is:
(Hawai aaloodgi ka aik tolidi (reproductive) aur nashonuma ka asar kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Aaloodgi mard aur aurat ki fertility par asar daal sakti hai; waqt se pehle paidaish aur bachon ki nashonuma ke masail ho sakte hain (14.10.1).

book_ref.quote: Premature birth and developmental problems in children may occur.

blocks.text: 14.11 Methods and techniques to measure and monitor air quality

blocks.prompt:
101 The instrument used to monitor particulate matter such as dust, smoke, mist and fumes is the:
(Dust, dhuan, dhund aur fumes jaise PM ko monitor karne wala aala kaun sa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Nephelometer AQI naapne aur dust, dhuan, dhund aur fumes jaise PM ko monitor karne ka aala hai (14.11).

book_ref.quote: The instrument used to measure air quality index (AQI) is nephelometer.

blocks.prompt:
102 A nephelometer (photometer) detects particles by measuring:
(Nephelometer (photometer) zarraat ko kis cheez ko naap kar pehchanta hai?)

options.text: un se bikharne wali kul roshni

blocks.explanation: Nephelometer zarraat se bikharne (scatter) wali kul roshni naap kar unhein pehchanta hai (14.11).

book_ref.quote: detects particles by measuring the total amount of light they scatter

blocks.prompt:
103 A Continuous Emission Monitoring System (CEMS) is usually used to monitor pollutants at:
(Continuous Emission Monitoring System (CEMS) zyada tar kahan pollutants monitor karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: CEMS zyada tar sanati jagahon (industrial sites) par CO, O₃, SO₂, NO₂, VOCs aur PM monitor karta hai (14.11.1).

book_ref.quote: can usually monitor gas like CO, O₃, SO₂, NO₂, VOCs and PM at industrial sites

blocks.prompt:
104 Measuring pollutants over large regional and global areas is done by:
(Bare ilaqai aur aalmi raqbe par pollutants ki pemaish kis se hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sensors wale satellites (remote sensing) bare raqbe par pollutants naapte hain (14.11.1).

book_ref.quote: Satellites equipped with sensors can measure atmospheric pollutants over large areas

blocks.prompt:
105 Fixed stations in urban and industrial zones that measure pollutant levels in real time are called:
(Shehri aur sanati ilaqon mein qaim stations jo foran pollutant ki satah naapte hain, kya kehlate hain?)
blocks.explanation: AQMS qaim stations hain jin mein sensors aur analysers foran pollutants naapte hain (14.11.1).

book_ref.quote: Fixed monitoring stations are equipped with various sensors and analyzers

blocks.text: 14.12 Experiments and data collection to test a hypothesis about air quality

blocks.prompt:
106 The first step in designing an experiment about air quality is to:
(Hawa ke mayaar par tajurba design karne ka pehla qadam kya hai?)
blocks.explanation: Pehle qadam mein hypothesis (mafrooza) banaya jata hai (14.12 i).

book_ref.quote: As a first step, a hypothesis is developed to design an experiment.

blocks.prompt:
107 To test whether PM 2.5 and NO₂ are higher in peak traffic hours, the sites selected for monitoring are:
(Yeh jaanchne ke liye ke rush ke auqaat mein PM 2.5 aur NO₂ zyada hote hain, monitoring ke liye kaun si jagahen chuni jati hain?)
blocks.explanation: Masroof sarkon aur rihaishi ilaqon ko monitoring ke liye chuna jata hai (14.12 ii).

book_ref.quote: Busy roads sites and residential areas are selected for monitoring.

blocks.text: 14.13 Analyse data and interpret air quality

blocks.prompt:
108 The collected air-quality data is analysed in order to:
(Jama kiya gaya data kis maqsad se analyse kiya jata hai?)

options.text: hypothesis ke sach ya ghalat hone ki tasdeeq
data se pehle naya hypothesis banana

blocks.explanation: Data ka analysis hypothesis ke sach ya ghalat hone ki tasdeeq ke liye hota hai (14.13).

book_ref.quote: The collected data is analyzed to confirm the truth or falseness of the hypothesis.

blocks.text: 14.14 Strategies used to reduce air pollution

blocks.prompt:
109 In a catalytic convertor, NOₓ are:
(Catalytic convertor mein NOₓ ka kya hota hai?)

options.text: oxidize ho kar NO₃ bante hain
reduce ho kar N₂ bante hain
soot ki shakal mein jama hote hain

blocks.explanation: Catalytic convertor mein CO oxidize ho kar CO₂ aur NOₓ reduce ho kar N₂ bante hain (14.14 i).

book_ref.quote: CO is oxidized to CO₂. NOₓ are reduced to N₂.

blocks.prompt:
110 In a catalytic convertor, unburnt hydrocarbons are converted into:
(Catalytic convertor mein unburnt hydrocarbons kis mein badalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Unburnt hydrocarbon CO₂ aur H₂O mein badal jata hai (14.14 i).

book_ref.quote: The unburnt hydrocarbon is converted to CO₂ and H₂O.

blocks.prompt:
111 The primary function of a diesel particulate filter (DPF) is to:
(Diesel particulate filter (DPF) ka bunyadi kaam kya hai?)

options.text: exhaust se soot ke zarre pakar kar jama karna
NOₓ ko N₂ mein reduce karna
SO₂ ko SO₃ mein oxidize karna
SO₂ ko paani mein ghol dena

blocks.explanation: DPF exhaust gases se soot (kalikh) ke zarraat pakar kar jama karta hai (14.14 ii).

book_ref.quote: The primary function of diesel particulate filter is to capture and store soot particles

blocks.prompt:
112 Catalysts used in selective catalytic reduction (SCR) include:
(Selective catalytic reduction (SCR) mein kaun se catalysts istemal hote hain?)
blocks.explanation: SCR mein TiO₂ aur zeolites jaise catalysts istemal hote hain (14.14 iii).

book_ref.quote: using catalysts, such as TiO₂, zeolites, etc.

blocks.prompt:
113 Scrubbers remove pollutants such as SO₂ and PM from industrial exhaust gases by using:
(Scrubbers sanati exhaust se SO₂ aur PM jaise pollutants kis cheez se nikalte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Scrubbers liquids (maslan H₂O) se sanati exhaust ki SO₂ aur PM nikalte hain (14.14 iv).

book_ref.quote: Scrubbers use liquids (e.g. H₂O) to remove pollutants such as SO₂, PM

blocks.prompt:
114 How many technologies to control emission of air pollutants does the chapter actually describe?
(Chapter asal mein ikhraj rokne ki kitni technologies bayan karta hai?)
blocks.explanation: Book correction: kitab paanch kehti hai magar chaar bayan karti hai: catalytic convertor, DPF, SCR aur scrubbers (14.14).

book_ref.quote: A variety of technologies is used to reduce air pollution and improve air quality.

blocks.prompt:
115 PEPA, a law to control air pollution in Pakistan, stands for:
(PEPA, Pakistan mein hawai aaloodgi rokne ka qanoon, kis ka mukhaffaf hai?)
blocks.explanation: PEPA Pakistan Environmental Protection Act 1997 hai (14.15.1).

book_ref.quote: Pakistan Environmental Protection Act (PEPA 1997)

blocks.prompt:
116 NEQS, the limits set under PEPA 1997, stands for:
(NEQS, jo PEPA 1997 ke tehat had muqarrar karta hai, kis ka mukhaffaf hai?)
blocks.explanation: Book correction: NEQS National Environmental Quality Standards hai, 'Natural' nahi (14.15.1).

book_ref.quote: Natural Environmental Quality Standard (NEQS)

blocks.prompt:
117 Under the vehicle emission standard, the cleaner fuels promoted are:
(Vehicle emission standard ke tehat kaun se saaf eendhan farogh diye jate hain?)
blocks.explanation: Vehicle emission standard CNG aur LPG jaise saaf eendhan ko farogh deta hai (14.15.2).

book_ref.quote: The promotion of cleaner fuels such as compressed natural gas (CNG), liquid petroleum gas (LPG)

blocks.prompt:
118 A specific smog control measure named in the chapter is:
(Chapter mein batayi gayi smog rokne ki aik khaas tadbeer kya hai?)

options.text: faslon ki baqiyat jalane par pabandi
kachre ko khule mein zyada jalana

blocks.explanation: Smog rokne ke liye faslon ki baqiyat jalane par pabandi aur smog towers ka istemal (14.15.2).

book_ref.quote: Restrictions the burning of crop residues, which is a major contributes to smog

blocks.prompt:
119 Reducing the permissible level of sulphur in diesel mainly cuts the emission of:
(Diesel mein sulphur ki ijazat shuda had kam karne se zyada tar kis ka ikhraj kam hota hai?)
blocks.explanation: Kam sulphur wala diesel SOₓ ka ikhraj kam karta hai, kyunke SOₓ aise eendhan jalane se bante hain (14.15.2, 14.4.3).

book_ref.quote: Use of low-Sulphur Diesel Reduction of permissible level of sulphur in diesel.

blocks.prompt:
120 Developing green belts and parks in urban areas is part of:
(Shehron mein green belts aur parks banana kis tadbeer ka hissa hai?)
blocks.explanation: Urban planning aur green infrastructure: green belts aur parks; traffic kam karna (14.15.2).

book_ref.quote: Development of green belts and parks in urban / areas to improve air quality.

blocks.prompt:
121 An economic issue caused by poor air quality is:
(Kharab hawa ka aik maashi (economic) masla kya hai?)

options.text: bimari aur ghair haaziri se mazdooron ki paidawar kam hona

blocks.explanation: Maashi: kaam ki salahiyat kam hona, faslon ka nuqsan aur khane ki qeematein barhna, acid rain se imaraton ka nuqsan (14.16.1).

book_ref.quote: Poor air quality can reduce worker productivity due to illness and absenteeism.

blocks.prompt:
122 Forced migration of people from polluted areas, leading to social displacement, is a:
(Aalooda ilaqon se logon ki majboori ki hijrat aur samaji be-ghari kis qisam ka masla hai?)
blocks.explanation: Shadeed aaloodgi se hijrat aur samaji be-ghari samaji (social) masla hai (14.16.2).

book_ref.quote: Severe air pollution can force people to migrate from the unhealthy polluted areas

blocks.prompt:
123 Effective management of air pollution needs international cooperation because:
(Hawai aaloodgi ke behtar intezam ke liye bain-ul-aqwami taawun kyun zaroori hai?)

options.text: har mulk ki hawa usi ke andar rehti hai
pollutants hawa ke saath safar nahi karte
sirf aik mulk aaloodgi paida karta hai
aaloodgi sarhadon tak mehdood nahi rehti

blocks.explanation: Hawai aaloodgi sarhadon tak mehdood nahi, is liye bain-ul-aqwami taawun chahiye (14.16.3).

book_ref.quote: Air pollution is not confined to borders and effective management requires international corporation.
